tasks.title: HANGS General Contracting · October 2026 Combined Excise Tax Return
tasks.description: Prepare the October 2026 Washington Combined Excise Tax Return for HANGS General Contracting from 8 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Work out B&O tax by classification, retail sales tax by job-site location and use tax on purchases made without sales tax. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft return. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.

light.reason: Waiting for review: draft package ready, open items remain

tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft Combined Excise Tax Return PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files.

lastRun.title: HANGS General Contracting · October 2026 Combined Excise Tax Return
lastRun.summary: Preparation calculations complete. Draft Package Ready · 4 Open Items · Unsigned Draft. A partial draft return and linked workpapers were generated. Required facts and supplementary forms remain incomplete. Human review and signature required; not filed.
